evidence.detail: pd500_date() computes the 500 date as seasons.next_rotation() - 5d13h30m; if the rotation date changes, this shifts the PD500 week unexpectedly
is_pd500_week() returns True if pd500_date() falls in the 7-day window starting from 'now'; a rotation-date change can silently flip this
Emergency patch 'temporary fix for 500 date for PD38' shifted the date by -7 days because the rotation changed — shows this class of bug has already occurred
Reverted the PD38 patch after that season, leaving no permanent fix

triage.notes: The bug reproduces whenever the rotation date is revised after the bot starts computing the 500 week. A robust fix would decouple the PD500 date from the computed rotation (e.g., store it explicitly per season or read it from the gatherling schedule). Scope exceeds easy-fix.
